Commentary.Commentary: We are moments away from the beginning of the second inning. The Australian players have made their way out to the field and are taking their positions. Martin Guptill and Devon Conway are the openers for New Zealand and will be looking to get off to a decent start. Mitchell Starc has been handed the new ball and he will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then, the visitors will be absolutely thrilled with their effort on the field and will look to their batters to guide them to a series-leveling win. They will know that they possess the batting to make this chase look easy but will try and preserve their wickets up the order. Australia will look to get a similar purchase off the wicket and try to get early breakthroughs. They will need to come out with self-belief and back their bowlers on the field. Will they be able to defend this low total and seal a series win? Or will the Kiwis take the series to a decider? We will find out soon. Do join us shortly for the run chase.

Matt Henry is up for a chat and he says that they did a good job and are happy with the overall bowling effort. Mentions that they wanted to take early wickets as Australia have a strong batting line-up and they are happy with the bowling performance.

Australia got off to another poor start losing their out-of-form captain Aaron Finch on a second-ball duck. David Warner played a few shots but departed soon after and was closely followed by Marnus Labuschagne and Marcus Stoinis back in the shed. Steven Smith seemed like the only batter not troubled in these conditions but because of the lack of support from the other end, he had to anchor the innings. He put on a 49-run partnership with Glenn Maxwell that helped push the score beyond the 100-run mark. Australia lost wickets in a bundle once again and both set batters departed along with Sean Abbott. Steven Smith made 61 but took 94 deliveries to get there. The 31-run partnership between Mitchell Starc and Adam Zampa initially followed by a 47-run unbeaten partnership between the former and Josh Hazlewood pushed the hosts close to the 200-run mark.

New Zealand won a good toss and were right at the throats of their opponents from the word go. Matt Henry and Trent Boult started wonderfully and bowled 6-over opening spells taking two wickets each. They controlled the middle overs with spin from one end and Mitchell Santner was rewarded with a wicket of his own. They were unable to take wickets for a short while thereafter, but the reintroduction of pace from both ends slowed the scoring rate even further. They began chipping away with wickets once again as the Aussies looked to accelerate and eventually restricted their opponents to an under-par score. Kane Williamson chose to use his front-line bowlers early leaving the part-time bowlers towards the end. They would have hoped to wipe out the tail sooner and only time will tell if the extra runs towards the end will cost them. Trent Boult was the pick of the bowlers taking 4 wickets for 38 runs in his full quota of 10 overs and was ably supported by Matt Henry who chipped in with three wickets of his own.

Australia have put up quite a resistance towards the end and have successfully played out the 50 overs! They have posted 195 runs on the board courtesy of their tail-enders but will feel they are well short of a reasonable target. The Black Caps did not end well but have come back strongly in this game after suffering defeat in the previous encounter. They will be silently confident of achieving the target and squaring up the series. The hosts will be disappointed with their batting effort as a whole and will need to come out with the intent to take early wickets if they are to stand a chance in this game.
So just a single to end the innings! This is a full delivery on off. Starc gets across and paddles it towards short fine leg. They cross for a single and Australia end with 195/9 after 50 overs!

That is sloppy from New Zealand! A yorker, outside off. Starc digs it out to point. The batters go for a single and the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and Neesham fails to collect it. The ball goes towards mid on and the batters take another run as the thow from mid on is towards the striker's end this time. Latham collects the throw and whips the bails off. However, Starc is well inside the crease there. Two taken.
A full toss on middle. Around the waist height and Josh Hazlewood manages to hit it left of the bowler for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Starc drills it to long off for a single.
SIX! That's in the arc and Starc launches it over the mid-wicket fence. A fullish delivery on off. In the slot and Starc hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tad shorter and around off. Starc cuts it to the cover fielder.
Michael Bracewell continues bowling full and Mitchell Starc taps this towards mid-wicket. He takes a single to keep strike for the last over.
Goes full this time and straight, Josh Hazlewood clips the ball towards deep mid-wicket and takes another single.
This is short as well and in line with the stumps, Mitchell Starc pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Pulls his length back and bowls this short angling into the pads, Josh Hazlewood tucks this towards the vacant fine leg region and they pick up three runs. Josh Hazlewood was not sure about the third run and in the end puts in a dive to make his ground. Three taken.

SIX! Lovely footwork from Josh Hazlewood! Michael Bracewell flights this one full and outside off, Josh Hazlewood shimmies down the wicket and hits the ball inside out over the deep cover boundary for a biggie. Useful runs for Australia here.
Michael Bracewell floats this one full and outside off, Mitchell Starc strokes the ball off the back foot towards deep cover for single.
Serves it on a length, on off. Josh Hazlewood blocks it out.
A full delivery, around off. Josh Hazlewood drives it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Bowls it very full ad outside off. Josh Hazlewood tries to drive it away but misses.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Josh Hazlewood! Goes fuller on middle. Josh Hazlewood drives it past the bowler for a boundary. Cruical runs this.
Angles a length delivery on the pads. Starc clips it to square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Starc blocks it out.
Tad shorter and on leg. Josh Hazlewood clips it to deep backward square leg for a couple.

Bowls it tad shorter and on middle and leg. Josh Hazlewood tries to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal but the umpire says no. Quite surprisngly, New Zealand do not take a review. The replays show that Josh Hazlewood was a goner there!
On the shorter side, on middle. Starc pulls it bit uppishly again to deep square leg for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Starc skips down the track and hits it aerially straight down the ground for a couple.
Bowls it flatter and quicker on middle. Starc plays it back to the bowler.
A flatter one and tad shorter on off. Starc punches it to covers.
Michael Bracewell will bowl another over. Not sure if this is necessary.
Single to end the over and Starc will retain the strike! Henry keeps it tad short and outside off. Starc cuts it to deep point for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Josh Hazlewood drives it right of mid on for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Starc cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Much-needed boundary for Australia! This is tad short and around off. Starc punches it past point for a lovely boundary. All timing there.
Back of a length, on middle. A slower delivery and Josh Hazlewood clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and outside off. Josh Hazlewood tries to cut it but misses.
Slower through the air, on off. Starc drives it back to the bowler this time.
Tossed up, on off. Starc defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it flatter and quicker on middle. Josh Hazlewood clips it to square leg for a single.
Keeps it tad short again, on off. Starc punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On the shorter side, on middle. Josh Hazlewood works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Josh Hazlewood defends it towards the off side.
Josh Hazlewood is the last batter out in the middle for Australia. Michael Bracewell has been given the ball for the first time in the game.

OUT! CAUGHT! Well, was this needed? Adam Zampa tries to hit Boult for a boundary off his last ball of this game but perishes in the process. Boult bowls it on a length and it is a slower delivery. Zampa makes room and tries to lift it over mid off. The ball, however, goes off the bottom of his blade and loops up in the air towards left of mid off. James Neesham runs to his left and takes a fine diving catch. Nine wicket down now.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: A very full delivery on middle. Starc drives it down the ground for a single.
A fullish delivery, on off. Starc defends it to covers. This is the last over of Boult and Aussies are looking happy to play him out here.
Goes fuller on off. Starc drives it to the mid off fielder.
Oh, that's a risky shot! Zampa makes room and shows all his three stumps. Boult bowls it full and on middle. Zampa steers it towards deep point for a single.
On a length, on off. Zampa defends it solidy from his crease.
Single to end the over. On a length, around off. Zampa punches it to covers for a single. Good little partnership building up for Australia.
Goes fuller, on off. Starc goes for a big slog. However, the ball goes off the inside half of his blade aerially towards long on for a single.
No, he bowls it on a length again, on off. Starc punches it to cover-point.
On a length, on off. Starc punches it to cover-point. Can Southee produce a brilliant yorker or a nasty bouncer here?
Short and wide outside off. Starc slashes hard at it but misses.
Comes 'round the wicket and angles it into middle. Starc clips it towards deep square leg for a couple.
Two more! This will be frustrating for the Kiwi bowlers. Boult bowls it short and around off. Zampa makes a bit of room and hits it over the cover fielder for a couple.
Nails a yorker this time, on leg. Zampa though does well and digs it out.
Serves it on a length, on off. Zampa blocks it from his crease.
WIDE! A slower bouncer, on off. Zampa sways away from the line of the ball. The umpire signals it wide for height.
On the shorter side, outside off. Starc punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Starc drives it straight to mid off.

FOUR! Another boundary for Australia! These are all crucial runs. Back of a length and around off. Starc opens the face of his blade at the last moment and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Trent Boult (8-2-28-3) has been brought back into the attack.
Goes fuller on off at 131 kph. Zampa looks to smash it over mid on but gets the inside edge onto his pads. Can Australia get over 160 from here?
Another single! On a length and around off. Starc pushes it to covers and takes a quick single.
Goes wider of the crease and bowls it full and on the pads. Zampa flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Bowls it full and on middle. Zampa clips it to square leg.
A fullish delivery, on off. Zampa drives it to covers this time.

FOUR! In the air...and just over Trent Boult at mid off! On a length and around off. Zampa stays in his crease and lifts it over mid off. He does not time it properly but gets enough to beat Boult as he jumps to catch it. Boundary!
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this innings.
This one is full as well and in line with the stumps, Mitchell Starc clips the ball towards mid on.
Matt Henry goes full and just outside off, Adam Zampa taps the ball towards cover with soft hands and takes a quick single.
Pulls his length back once again and on off, Mitchell Starc mistimes his pull towards deep square leg for a single.
Matt Henry serves this one on a good length and outside the off stump, Mitchell Starc looks to drive but is beaten on the outside edge.
Slightly shorter and delivered outside off, Mitchell Starc looks to cut but gets an under edge into the pitch towards the off side.
Matt Henry bowls this on a good length and close to the off pole, Mitchell Starc defends the ball back to the bowler's left.
Wide outside off on a fuller length, Adam Zampa lofts the ball into the gap in the offside and they take a couple of runs as the ball is stopped before the deep cover fence.
Tim Southee pulls his length back a fraction and bowls this towards the batter. Adam Zampa stands tall and blocks the ball back down the pitch.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and angling in from outside off, Adam Zampa defends this solidly towards cover.

FOUR! Wonderful shot from Adam Zampa! Australia need many more of these. Tim Southee strays onto the pads on a fuller length, Adam Zampa does not miss out as he clips the ball towards deep square leg for four valuable runs.
This is a touch fuller and outside off, Adam Zampa defends this into the cover region.
Tim Southee bowls on a good length and outside off, Adam Zampa knocks the ball back towards the bowler.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside off, Mitchell Starc plays this straight to cover.
Mitchell Starc plays a release shot. Matt Henry serves this one full and straight, Mitchell Starc slogs this just over the mid-wicket fielder and takes a couple of runs.
Pitched up, outside off. Starc drives it without much timing to mid off.
Matt Henry bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Mitchell Starc blocks the ball towards cover.
This is delivered back of a length and outside off, Mitchell Starc guides this towards point.
Matt Henry serves a good-length delivery outside the off stump, Mitchell Starc is happy to leave this one alone.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and angled into the stumps, Adam Zampa tucks the ball towards square leg.
Delivers this one in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Adam Zampa blocks the ball back towards the bowler.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and outside off, Mitchell Starc guides the ball to third man to get off the mark.
Adam Zampa walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! New Zealand get the big wicket of Steven Smith and Australia are now in serious trouble! Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and just outside the off pole, Steven Smith looks to heave this towards the leg side but does not connect well. He gets a top edge and the ball goes high towards mid on. Trent Boult settles under the ball and takes an easy catch. There were many overs remaining and Steven Smith could have spent some more time at the wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Trent Boult b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Tim Southee pulls his length back and serves this on a good length, Steven Smith knocks the ball towards mid on.

SIX! Steven Smith gets his first maximum of the game! Tim Southee serves one full and on the pads, Steven Smith flicks this with ease over the deep backward square leg for a biggie. Is Steven Smith going to change his strategy now?
Matt Henry bowls this fuller and outside off, Mitchell Starc blocks this solidly towards cover. A wicket and just one run from Matt Henry's over.
Mitchell Starc walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Matt Henry bowls this wider outside off on a good length, Sean Abbott gets room to sway his arms and hits the ball uppishly towards cover. Mitchell Santner takes a fine catch as the ball is fired at him at a great speed. Australia have lost their seventh wicket. Someone needs to stick around and support Steven Smith.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Santner b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: This is a touch fuller and outside off, Sean Abbott blocks the ball towards the cover fielder.
Matt Henry serves this one on a good length and straight, Sean Abbott clips the ball to square leg.
Delivers this on a good length as well and in line with the stumps, Sean Abbott blocks the ball towards mid on.
Matt Henry bowls this on a good length and angling into the pads, Steven Smith clips the ball towards fine leg for a single.
Matt Henry is back on.
Another dot to end the over and just two from the over! Lands another length delivery on off. Sean Abbott stays deep in his crease and blocks it out.
Looks for a single but is sent back by Smith. Serves it on a length, around off. Sean Abbott pushes it with soft hands towards the off side and sets off for a single but is sent back.
Dot ball again! Tim Southee is right on target again with his line and length and Sean Abbott only manages to defend it from his crease.
Serves a length delivery on off. Sean Abbott blocks it out.
On a length, on middle. Sean Abbott clips it towards the leg side.

Nicely timed! Back of a length and around off. Sean Abbott punches it through covers for a couple. Actually, Sean Abbott did not touch his bat inside the crease in the first go, so he came back to do it again and that is why they had to settle for two runs.
Lands it on a good length and outside off. Smith makes a careful leave.
Bowls it fuller and on middle. Sean Abbott clips it wide of mid on for a single.
On a length, on middle. Sean Abbott clips it to square leg.

FOUR! Again and outside edge but this time it runs away for a boundary. Serves it on a good length and around off. Sean Abbott pushes at it. However, the ball goes off the thick outside edge of his blade and runs through the gap between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Serves it on a length and around off. Sean gets the thick outside edge this time and the ball rolls away towards backward point.
Lands it on a good length and around off. Sean Abbott tries to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge of his blade.
Lands it on a length, on off. Smith blocks it from his crease. End of a successful over from Trent Boult!

DRINKS! The players will take a short break. Just as Australia looked to be setting a platform for the two set batters to accelerate, Glenn Maxwell has been dismissed. New Zealand have sustained the pressure by bowling with discipline and have not given the hosts an opportunity to claw back into the game. Australia will need their tail to wag if they are to reach a competitive total and most of the load will be on the shoulders of Steven Smith. He has been joined by Sean Abbott and they still have lots of work to do here.

OUT! CAUGHT! The move to bring Trent Boult back into the attack has paid rich dividends! He gets rid of Glenn Maxwell and breaks this partnership. This was probably going to be the last over of this spell and Maxwell just needed to play out these last two deliveries. However, his patience runs out finally and that means that Australia are six down now. This is clever bowling from Boult though, he bowls it short and angles it into the body from 'round the wicket. Maxwell goes for the pull shot. However, he gets a top edge and the ball goes in the air towards deep square leg. Martin Guptill there runs to his left, makes some ground and dives full-length in the end to take a fantastic catch. Important breakthrough this!
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on off. Maxwell defends it from his crease.
Bowls it fuller and on middle. Maxwell clips it to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off. Maxwell punches it to covers this time.
On a length, on middle. Smith clips it to deep square leg for a single.

Goes fuller and on the pads. Maxwell tries to clip it but misses. Tom Latham takes the catch and the Kiwis appeal. However, the umpire is not interested. He actually was setting up to signal it wide but then decides to not make that call. Actually, the replays show that the umpire is right as it brushes the thigh pad on its way to the keeper. Maxwell was not happy with that call though.
Four dots in a row now! On a length, on middle. Maxwell clips it to square leg. Neesham is really testing Maxwell's patience here!
Another dot! Back of a length, on off. Maxwell dabs it towards backward point.
A full delivery on middle. Maxwell flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls it very full, on off. Maxwell drive it to mid off. Just getting the feeling that Maxwell is going to explode here.
On a length and outside off. Smith drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Two more to end the over! A fullish delivery on the pads. Maxwell clips it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
A fullish delivery and around off. Smith drives it to covers for a single.
On a length and around off. Smith defends it towards the off side again.
On a length and around off. Smith dabs it towards backward point.

FOUR! Fifty for Steven Smith! This has been a good knock under pressure, this is what makes him a great player. He brings his best game out when the chips are down and he has done exactly that today. This is short on middle. A slower bouncer and Smith gets a top edge as he tries to pull it. The ball goes over the keeper's head and into the fine leg fence.

A fullish delivery, on off. Maxwell pushes it to cover-point and sets off for a single. James Neesham there picks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses the stumps but hits Maxwell on his back.
Trent Boult is back on. This will be a crucial spell. Can he break this partnership?
James Neesham bowls this full and just outside off, Glenn Maxwell uses his wrists and works the ball to deep mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.

DROPPED! This was a difficult chance by a chance nonetheless! James Neesham decides to continue bowling full and in line with the stumps, Glenn Maxwell hits this hard back towards the bowler. James Neesham sticks out his left hand but the ball does not stick and Glenn Maxwell gets a lifeline.

FOUR! This runs away fine and gets Australia a boundary! That should release some pressure. James Neesham bowls this on a good length and outside off, Glenn Maxwell looks to guide this towards third man but gets it much finer than he expected. The ball races away to the boundary to add four runs to his kitty.
James Neesham bowls this full and angling into the pads, Glenn Maxwell clips this towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! James Neesham bowls this full and well outside the off stump. The umpire calls this wide.
On a length, on middle. Maxwell clips it left of mid-wicket. Martin Guptill there dives and stops it.
James Neesham begins the over with a full delivery angled into the stumps, Glenn Maxwell looks to heave but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Mitchell Santner flights a full delivery in line with the stumps, Steven Smith pushes the ball to the right of bowler who dives and parries the ball towards mid-wicket.

Mitchell Santner floats this one full and straight, Steven Smith looks to hit aerially but is early into the shot. Adjusts at the last moment and lobs the ball over the bowler's head. The ball lands safely and they take a couple of runs.
Mitchell Santner bowls one short and outside off, Glenn Maxwell uses the crease well to slap this towards deep cover for a single.
Floats this one wider outside off on a fuller length, Glenn Maxwell defends this towards cover.
Mitchell Santner bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Glenn Maxwell blocks this back to the bowler.

SIX! This has been dismissed! A much-needed boundary for Australia. Mitchell Santner drags the ball short and outside off, Glenn Maxwell goes well back in the crease and pulls the ball over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. This could get Glenn Maxwell and Australia going.
James Neesham bowls this on a good length and outside off, Steven Smith knocks this towards point. Just one run from the over.

This is full once again and in line with the stumps, Glenn Maxwell hits this well back towards the bowler who gets down and gets his fingertips to the ball. Takes some pace off and they take a single while the mid on fielder comes across and collects the ball.
James Neesham keeps bowling full outside off, Glenn Maxwell isn't being able to time his shots well as hit hits this one straight to short cover.
Goes full once again and angles the ball into the stumps, Glenn Maxwell defends the ball towards mid on.
Delivers this one back of a length and outside off, Glenn Maxwell gets on top of this and blocks the ball towards point.
James Neesham begins the over with a full delivery outside off, Glenn Maxwell gets forward and pushes the ball to mid off.
Tad shorter and quicker this time, on off. Smith punches it to covers. Another tight over from Mitchell Santner!
Slower through the air, on middle. Maxwell drives it to long on for a single.
This is drifting into the pads on a fuller length, Glenn Maxwell clips this straight to wide mid on.
Bowls this one a touch shorter and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith rocks back and punches the ball to long on for one.
Bowls this one full and outside off stump as well, Steven Smith blocks this towards cover.
Mitchell Santner flights a full delivery outside off, Glenn Maxwell looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards short third man who dives to his left and keeps the batters to a single.
Pulls his length back a fraction and outside the off pole, Steven Smith mistimes his shot towards cover.
This one is on a good length as well and outside off, Steven Smith blocks this towards point.

James Neesham bowls this on a good length and angles this down leg, Glenn Maxwell looks to tuck this around his leg but misses and the ball rolls off his pads towards backward square leg. They take a leg bye.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside off, Glenn Maxwell looks to push this towards the off side but gets an inside edge towards mid on.
James Neesham bowls this on a good length and aims for the stumps, Glenn Maxwell blocks the ball towards mid-wicket.
James Neesham serves a full delivery wide outside off, Steven Smith gets his front foot forward and plays a good-looking shot towards deep cover for a single.
Mitchell Santner fires this one full and in line with the stumps, Glenn Maxwell knocks this hard back towards the bowler. Maiden over for Mitchell Santner.
A flatter one on middle and leg. Glenn Maxwell goes back and looks to clip it but misses and gets hit on his pads.
Bowls it fuller and slower through the air, on off. Glenn Maxwell drives it with the angled blade towards backward point.
Bowls it flatter and quicker on middle. Glenn Maxwell blocks it out.
On the shorter side, on off. Glenn Maxwell punches it to covers.
Shorter and outside off. Glenn Maxwell tries to cut it. The kepeer also fails to collect it cleanly but no run taken.
On a good length, on off. Smith makes another solid block.
A fullish delivery on off. Smith blocks it off the front foot.

Well played by Maxi! This is on the shorter side and outside off. Glenn Maxwell waits for it and punches it through backward point. The fielder in ring runs behind it and cuts it off but the batters still run three.
On a length, on middle. Smith works it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Bit of luck there for Steven Smith! A good-length delivery that swings in. Smith tries to drive it towards the off side. However, the ball catches the inside edge of his blade and the ball goes past stumps and away from the diving Tom Latham behind the stumps. Boundary!
A fullish delivery on middle. Smith clips it to mid-wicket.
Tad shorter again, on middle. Smith punches it to long on for a single. Just a single from the over!
Fraction shorter, on middle. Smith punches it off the back foot to the left of mid-wicket.
Clever change of pace as he bowls it a bit quicker. Smith is happy to not take risks at the moment and keeps it out.
Nicely tossed up, on middle. Smith defends it solidy off the front foot.
Goes fuller on middle again. Smith works it towards the leg side.
A flatter one on middle. Smith blocks it out.

This one brushes the pads on its way. Southee bowls it full and on leg. Maxwell tries to flick it but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards the keeper. Southee makes an appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Southee continues to bowl in that channel, around off. Maxwell is happy to defend it yet again.
On a length and around off. Glenn Maxwell fends it towards the off side.
Serves it on a length, on off. Glenn Maxwell blocks it out from his crease. Can Glenn Maxwell curtail his natural game here?
Angles it into the pads. Smith clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on middle. Smith defends it towards the leg side.
Shorter in length, on off. Smith punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Smith with a solid front foot defence this time.

Bowls a flatter one on middle. Tad shorter as well and Smith looks to clip it away. The ball hits him high on the pads and there is an appeal from the bowler. However, it is sliding down leg and the umpire says no.
On the shorter side, on middle. Smith pulls it towards the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Smith uses his feet and Mitchell Santner drags his length back, on of. Smith defends it right of the bowler.
A flatter one on off. Glenn Maxwell pushes it to covers for a single.
Tim Southee serves this one fuller and outside off, Glenn Maxwell strokes this towards mid off and takes a quick single as the fielder is found on his heels.

Tim Southee bowls this a touch fuller and angles the ball into the stumps, Glenn Maxwell works this towards mid-wicket. He has gotten off to a watchful start. Is this the calm before the storm? Australia will definitely be hoping for it.
This is closer to the off pole on a good length, Glenn Maxwell looks to defend and gets a leading edge towards point.
Goes a touch fuller and angles the ball into the pads, Steven Smith clips the ball to deep square leg and gets off strike with a run.
This is on a good length as well and outside the off stump, Steven Smith blocks the ball towards point.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Glenn Maxwell tucks this to deep square leg and takes a single.
Mitchell Santner bowls a loopy delivery full and just outside off, Steven Smith lunges forward and defends the ball back down the pitch. Three runs and a wicket from this over.
Continues to float the ball full and outside off, Glenn Maxwell strokes this to deep cover for a single.
Mitchell Santner flights one full and outside off, Glenn Maxwell blocks the ball towards short mid off.
Glenn Maxwell is the next batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! New Zealand have the breakthrough and it is Mitchell Santner who delivers! He floats one full and outside off, Alex Carey goes for a reverse sweep but misses and drags his back foot out off the crease as he looks to play the shot. Tom Latham collects the ball and whips the bails off in a jiffy. He is confident as he is already celebrating the wicket. The leg umpire goes upstairs and they check UltraEdge first. There is no bat involved and the side angle shows that Alex Carey has nothing behind the crease. It is just a difference of one frame but he has to make the long walk back. Australia have lost half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: st Tom Latham b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Is this stumped? Alex Carey does not look very confident. The replays roll in and first they check whether there is any bat involved or not? The answer is no for that. Now, they check for the stumping and after taking some time and looking through various angles, the third umpire gives it OUT! There was nothing behind the crease and Alex Carey has to walk back.
Mitchell Santner bowls this a touch shorter and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith uses the depth of the crease and pushes the ball to long on for a run.
Mitchell Santner flights one full and on middle, Alex Carey shimmies down the wicket and flicks the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Keeps bowling straight on a good length, Steven Smith knocks the ball straighter this time past the mid on fielder and takes a couple of runs.
Straighter this time in line with the stumps and on a fuller length, Steven Smith punches this towards mid on.
James Neesham keeps prodding outside off stump on a fuller length, Steven Smith defends this towards mid off.
James Neesham bowls a touch fuller outside off, Steven Smith is watchful as he blocks the ball towards short cover.
Strays onto the pads on a fuller length, Alex Carey flicks the ball wide of deep square leg and takes one run.
James Neesham begins with a good-length delivery outside off, Alex Carey knocks the ball towards wide mid off.
Bowls this a touch quicker and outside off, Steven Smith is deep in the crease and he manages to keep this out towards cover-point.
Full and angled into the pads, Alex Carey clips the ball to deep square leg and takes a single.
Floats this one full and closer to the stumps, Alex Carey gets a stride forward and blocks the ball to the left of the bowler.
Mitchell Santner comes over the wicket to the left-hander and serves this full outside off, Alex Carey defends this back down the pitch.
Angles this one into the stumps as well on a fuller length, Steven Smith knocks this to long off for a run.
Mitchell Santner begins with a flighted delivery served full and angled into the stumps, Steven Smith blocks this back towards the bowler.

Drinks break. This has been a brilliant start from the Kiwis! Matt Henry and Trent Boult used the new ball perfectly and they have Australia on the back foot now. Australia need this pair of Steven Smith and Alex Carey to bat as long as possible now but it will not be an easy task against the disciplined bowling attack of New Zealand. Can Alex Carey along with Smith script another fightback for Australia? Let's find out as we will now see spin for the first time in this game. Mitchell Santner is into the attack.
Goes wide outside off this time on a good length, Steven Smith knocks this to deep cover and takes a run to keep strike. Four runs have come from this over and New Zealand continue to keep it tight.
James Neesham goes a touch fuller and outside the off pole, Steven Smith gets his front foot forward and defends the ball back towards the bowler.
Continues bowling on the good length and straight, Steven Smith stands tall and blocks the ball to the right of the bowler.
James Neesham serves this one a good length as well and in line with the middle stump, Steven Smith tucks this past mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
On a good length once again and in line with the stump, Steven Smith gets squared up but manages to block the ball back into the pitch from the top part of his bat.
James Neesham begins the over with a good-length delivery outside off stump, Alex Carey guides it to wide third man for a single.
Goes full on middle. Smith defends it towards mid on.

Tight run! A fullish delivery, on off. Carey drives it right of the cover fielder and sets off for a run. The fielder there has a shy at the batter's end but misses. Smith actually would have been in even if that would have hit.
On a length, on off. Carey defends it back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off. Carey drives it hard but finds the fielder at cover again.
Goes fuller and on off at 115 kph. Good slower delivery and Carey just pushes it to the short cover fielder.
On a length and around off. Carey drives it to the cover fielder.
Drags his length back a bit, around off. Carey punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Beats the outside edge of the blade this time! James Neesham very cleverly goes full and outside off. Carey goes chasing for it but gets beaten.
Continues to bowl it on a length, on middle. Smith clips it past square leg for a single.
On a length and around off. Smith defends it with the angled blade towards point.
Lands on a length, on off. Smith block it again. He is key here for Australia!
On a length, on middle. Smith defends it from his crease to mid on.
Change from both ends for New Zealand as James Neesham has been brought into the attack.
Pitched up, on off. Carey drives it but straight to mid off. Just one from Southee's first over!
Lands it on a length and outside off. Carey is in no mood to take any risk here and makes a careful leave.
A fullish delivery, around off. Carey tries to drive it away. However, the ball goes off the inside half of his blade towards the leg side.
Goes fuller and on middle. Smith clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it on a good length and outside off. Smith leaves it alone.

Ohh, Smith almost got himself out there! Southee starts off with a length delivery on off. Smith defends it onto the turf and sees the ball rolling towards the stumps. He pushes the ball away with his bat and it goes past just away from the stumps.
On a length and angling into middle. Smith clips it to fine leg for a single.
Another delivery that is in that channel, on off. Smith is patient enough to block it again.
Bowls it on a length, on middle. Smith defends it solidly from his crease.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Carey tries to drive it. However, the ball goes off the thick outside edge of his blade to third man for a single.
Goes fuller, on off. Carey drives it to mid off this time.
Henry continues and serves it on a length, on off. Carey defends it off the front foot.
Goes 'round the wicket and lands it on a good length, outside off. Smith makes a watchful leave.
On a length, on off. Smith blocks it from his crease.
Goes fuller on middle. Smith flicks it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
FOUR! A rare error from Boult and Smith gets four crucial runs. On a length, around leg. Smith clips it and does to fine as the ball races away towards the fence.
Back of a length and around off. Smith rides the bounce and pushes it towards the off side.
Lands it on a length, around off. Smith defends it from his crease.
We are into the Powerplay 2 now! A maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Matt Henry serves this one fuller and outside off, Alex Carey gets a stride forward and punches the ball straight to the left of the mid off fielder. There is not enough power in this shot and they take two runs to complete the over.
Beaten! Matt Henry persists with the outside off stump line on a good length, Alex Carey pushes at the ball but gets beaten as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Matt Henry is bowling good lengths here and serves this one outside the off stump. Alex Carey pushes at the ball and gets a leading edge towards backward point.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Alex Carey gets behind the line this time and knocks the ball to mid off.
Goes a touch fuller but continues to tempt the batter outside the off stump, Alex Carey is happy to leave this one alone as well.
Matt Henry begins the over with a good-length delivery angling away from the left-hander, Alex Carey leaves this one alone.
Pulls his length back a fraction and bowls this on a good length, Steven Smith steps across the stumps and bunts the ball towards cover.
Trent Boult continues bowling full and just outside off, Steven Smith blocks this back down the pitch.
Trent Boult serves this one full and angling into the pads, Alex Carey clips the ball to deep square leg and they take three runs as the fielder cuts out the boundary.
Alex Carey is the next batter in.

OUT! PLUMB!  Australia are falling apart here! Trent Boult strikes once again and traps the batter in front of the wicket. He serves a fraction fuller delivery pitching in line with the middle stump and gets the ball to straighten after pitching. Marcus Stoinis does not move his feet and is trapped deep in the crease as the ball crashes into the pads. Trent Boult turns around and enquires with the umpire who has no hesitation in lifting his finger. Marcus Stoinis decides to review and UltraEdge shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracking indicates that the ball is hitting the middle of the middle stump and this has been a poor review from Australia. They lose their fourth wicket and are in some serious trouble.
Continues bowling full and outside off, Steven Smith knocks this to the left of mid off and rushes across for a quick run.
Trent Boult bowls a full delivery swinging into the pads, Steven Smith taps this back to the bowler's right.
This one is wider outside off on a good length, Marcus Stoinis knocks this towards cover-point. Just three runs from this over.
Matt Henry bowling on a good length consistently and outside the off pole, Marcus Stoinis blocks this back towards the bowler.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside off, Marcus Stoinis defends this towards mid off.
This is on a good length and angling into the pads, Steven Smith tucks this down to fine leg and takes a run.
Matt Henry goes a touch fuller and outside off, Steven Smith goes for the drive and gets a leading edge past point for a brace.
Matt Henry serves this one on a good length and in the outside off stump channel. Steven Smith shoulders his arms to this one.

Trent Boult goes really full this time but gets the ball swinging down leg, Marcus Stoinis misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal from the bowler but the umpire is not interested. End of a successful over for New Zealand.
Trent Boult serves a good-length delivery shaping away from the batter from outside off, Marcus Stoinis is watchful as he lets this one through to the keeper.
Marcus Stoinis walks out at number 5!

OUT! LBW! Trent Boult has been rewarded for his disciplined bowling! He serves a fullish delivery pitching in line with the middle stump, gets the ball to nip back in and Marnus Labuschagne plays outside the line of the ball. Gets hit flush on the pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Marnus Labuschagne decides to review this. UltraEdge shows no bat is involved and the Ball Tracking shows three red. Marnus Labuschagne has to depart and Australia have lost their third wicket.
Delivers this one outside off on a fuller length, Marnus Labuschagne gets a stride forward and works this into the gap to the left of mid off. They take a couple of runs.
This is one a good length and swinging into the pads, Marnus Labuschagne tucks this towards mid-wicket.
Trent Boult begins with a fuller delivery outside off, Steven Smith knocks the ball towards straightish mid off and takes a quick single.
Delivers this on a fuller length and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne knocks this to wide mid off.
Matt Henry bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump, Marnus Labuschagne is happy to leave this one alone.
Straying onto the pads on a fuller length, Steven Smith clips the ball towards deep square leg and takes an easy single.
Goes a touch fuller but continues bowling outside off, Steven Smith strokes this straight to the cover fielder.
Bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole, Steven Smith plays this with soft hands towards cover.

FOUR! This has been slapped away! Matt Henry begins the over with a short delivery outside the off stump, Steven Smith rocks back quickly and pulls that ball towards the deep square leg fence for four runs.
On a length and around off. Marnus Labuschagne defends it from his crease this time.
Tad shorter and on middle. Marnus Labuschagne tucks it towards the leg side.
Goes fuller, on off. Hint of away swing again. Marnus Labuschagne tries to drive it away. However, the ball takes the outside edge of his blade again and goes towards backward point again.
Pulls his length back a bit. On off. Marnus Labuschagne blocks it out.

Ohh...finds an outside edge this time! A fullish delivery on off. Marnus Labuschagne tries to flick it. However, the ball catches the outside edge of his blade and goes towards the backward point fielder.
Lands it on a good length and outside off. It is angled across the batter and Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Lands it on a length and angles it into middle. Smith clips it to square leg.
Slight halt! It seems like Steven Smith wants a change of bat. He has the replacement and we are set to resume play.
Serves it on a length again, around off. Smith goes back and defends it solidly again.
On a length, on off. Smith defends it from his crease.
FOUR! Smith with a classy shot this time! Henry bowls an overpitched delivery on off. Smith shows the full face of his blade and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Nice timing by Marnus Labuschagne! A very full delivery on middle. Marnus Labuschagne drives it past the bowler and comes back for three runs as the fielder at mid on cuts it off.
Marnus Labuschagne strides out to the middle and Australia will now need a partnership to build their innings.

OUT! TAKEN! Matt Henry strikes again and this time it is a big wicket of David Warner! Both the openers are back in the hut now and Australia are in a spot of bother here. Henry bowls it on a fullish length, around off. Warner tries to clear the mid off fielder as he did in the last over with a lofted drive. However, he gets no timing on this one and ends up hitting it straight to Kane Williamson at mid off. He takes it easily and this is just the start New Zealand wanted.
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Williamson b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot ball to end the over! On a length, on off. Smith blocks it from his crease.
Bowls it full and on the pads. Smith clips it to square leg this time.
Back of a length, on off. Smith blocks it from his crease.
Squares him up this time! A good-length delivery, around off. It goes away from the batter and Warner gets a thick outside edge to third man as he tries to defend it. Single taken.
FOUR! Warner is off the mark with a boundary! A fullish delivery on off. Warner lifts it over mid off for a boundary. Typical David Warner shot!
A fullish delivery, around off. Smith defends it off the front foott towards point for a single.
Another solid block from Warner! He is in no hurry here. Eight balls and yet to get off the mark. On a length, on off. Warner is right behind it and defends it.
On a length, on off. Warner blocks it solidly off the back foot.
Serves it on a length and around off. Smith dabs it towards backward point for a single.
On a good length and outside off. Smith leaves it alone.
Steven Smith is the new batter out in the middle at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Aaron Finch departs early yet again and the poor run of form of the Australian skipper continues. He tried to be aggressive here but it is a poor shot in the end and he departs without scoring a run. On a length and around off. Finch looks to go over the top and throws his bat towards the ball without using his feet. The ball goes off the bottom of his blade towards left of mid off and Kane Williamson takes an easy catch. Pressure building on the Australian skipper!
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Williamson b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: It is just short of good length and on off. Finch defends it from his crease.
Matt Henry will share the attack with Trent Boult and bowl from the other end.
Maiden to start by Boult! Drags his length back, on off. Warner blocks it off the back foot.
Bowls a fullish delivery again. It swing away from Warner again and he drives it off the outside half of his blade to point.
Serves a fullish delivery, on off. Warner drives it off the outside half of his blade to point.
Goes bit fullish and around off. Warner decides to leave it again as the ball swings away from him sharply.
On a length and outside off. Warner lets it go again.
Boult starts with a good-length delivery, outside off. Warner leaves it alone. Hint of away shape there.

We are moments away from the start of the match! The New Zealand players are out there in the middle. David Warner and Aaron Finch are the openers for Australia. Trent Boult to start with the ball for New Zealand. David Warner will take the strike. Here we go...

Will Aaron Finch fire today? The Australian skipper needs some runs under his belt to get that confidence back. However, he has Trent Boult and Tim Southee to deal with. Also, Matt Henry is pretty good with the new ball and Finch need to find a way to tackle those inswinging deliveries early in his innings.

So, both teams have made one change in their playing XI from the last game. Cameron Green is not playing today after his heroics in the last game and will be replaced by Sean Abbott. The young all-rounder probably needs some more rest before he is ready to create some more impact with his all-round skills. New Zealand, on the other hand, have decided to go with the experience of Tim Southee in place of Lockie Ferguson in this game.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Devon Conway, Kane Williamson (C), Tom Latham (WK), Daryl Mitchell, Michael Bracewell, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Matt Henry, Tim Southee (In place of Lockie Ferguson), Trent Boult.

Australia (Playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Marcus Stoinis, Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Sean Abbott (In place of Cameron Green), Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of New Zealand. They have elected to BOWL first.

New Zealand also would be disappointed with their batting effort. Their bowlers bowled exceptionally to nearly pull off an improbable win but it was their late collapse with the bat that actually cost them the game. The pitch was a tricky one in the first game and with all games to be played in the same venue, the batters from both sides need to apply themselves better this time around. Can the Kiwis fightback and level the series? Or will Australia take an unassailable lead of 2-0? Let's find out. Toss and teams news in a bit.
